fee_notes: Standard single-unit Initial Franchise Fee is $39,900. Reduced fees apply in the following cases: (1) Existing franchisee adding a second or further location (new build): $20,000 each; (2) Existing franchisee converting an independent business (Conversion Franchise): $10,000 each; (3) Honorably discharged U.S. military veterans, first responders, or spouses of either ("Veterans and First Responders Program"): $29,900. Discounts may not be combined. Under a Multi-Unit Agreement, the fee is $39,900 for the first center, $20,000 for the second, and $15,000 for each additional (minimum Multi-Unit Fee of $35,000). All initial fees are nonrefundable.
raw_excerpt: The "Initial Franchise Fee" for a single SpeeDee Center is $39,900. ... we offer a reduced Initial Franchise Fee of $10,000 for each such additional location that is open and operating and you convert to a SpeeDee Center. ... we offer a reduced Initial Franchise Fee of $29,900 for a single SpeeDee Center ("Veterans and First Responders Program"). ... a multi-unit fee ("Multi-Unit Fee") equal to a reduced Initial Franchise Fee of $20,000 for the second SpeeDee Center, and a reduced Initial Franchise Fee of $15,000 for each additional SpeeDee Center you intend to open under the Multi-Unit Agreement.
